inspector.title: Provided pituitary MRI case 1 and published source annotations
inspector.modality: Provided processed contrast-enhanced MRI, registered T2 and source-mask boundaries
inspector.caption: Inspect a separate published source case with T1 contrast-enhanced MRI, supplied registered T2, a tumour–gland complex annotation and combined carotid annotation. The provided grid is 0.5 mm; reported T1 acquisition was 0.488 × 0.488 × 1.5 mm. Display uses supplied sforms; the annotation qform displacement of 22.5 mm is retained and disclosed. No current-patient or SPL-atlas registration is applied.
inspector.attribution:
Source: A. S. Pandit, A. Keenlyside, D. Z. Khan, G. Reischer, M. A. Kamal, N. Yoh, Z. Jaunmuktane, A. Borg, N. L. Dorward, S. E. Baldeweg, I. Davagnanam, H. Hyare, P. Nachev and H. J. Marcus.
Mapping pituitary neuroendocrine tumors: an annotated MRI dataset profiling tumor and carotid characteristics.
Dataset: https://doi.org/10.6084/m9.figshare.27894084.v1
Paper: https://doi.org/10.1038/s41597-024-04218-8
Dataset licence: Creative Commons Attribution4.0 International, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
The source publisher explicitly applies this licence to the data; source metadata and unmodified original small annotation files are retained.
Marked adaptation, Primer, 2026-11-01: coordinate-header analysis and comparison display from original provided processed MRI samples with original-mask display lookup. No source sample/header changes or corrective registration were made. Not an independent anatomical, biological-boundary or clinical approval. No source-author or institutional endorsement is implied.
